text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Curious about what I'm reading? It's a 
novel—a mystery, in fact."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A perplexing case that occurred in a rural 
village... The truth of a prestigious 
family, and complex human relationships.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It makes total sense, and the culprit's 
motive is clear. You've really thought 
this through.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...To rise through the ranks of the 
family. Quietly, calculatingly using 
whatever I can—yes. Fufu, hohoho..."
